description: Manages different types of documents that can be associated with various business entities within the system.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated and sortable list of document types. Optionally, results can be filtered by an associated entity name. This endpoint supports pagination and sorting.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to filter document types by (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project', 'Contract'). If not provided, all document types are returned.

pageIndex.description: The page number for pagination. Use -1 for no pagination (default: -1).

pageSize.description: The number of items per page for pagination (default: 10).

orderBy.description: The field name to sort the results by (e.g., 'Name', 'Description').

ascending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order (true) or descending order (false) (default: true).

example_uses: Get all document types available in the system.
List document types specifically for the 'Partner' entity.
Retrieve document types, paginated with 20 items per page and sorted by name in ascending order.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of document types, either globally or specific to a particular business entity, for display, selection, or validation purposes in user interfaces or automated processes.
